body: PATHS F3: bin/ tem so bs-agent-notify.cjs e bs-claude-hook.cjs. Drop-box = .bridgespace/claude-hooks/global/*.json no padrao term_<termId>--<epochMs>-<evento>.json (eventos vistos: session-start, user-prompt-submit, stop); ha tambem claude-hooks/scopes/<scopeId>.json e agent-hooks/global/ (ex.: codex-stop). Shell integration em ~/Library/Application Support/io.bridgemind.bridgespace/shell-integration/.
